name: loom-code
description: A VS Code coding agent with a fast Go backend, approval-aware tools, sessions, modes, MCP, and local indexing.

loom.provider.markdownDescription:
**Loom: Provider**

LLM provider. Use `openai-compatible` for Azure OpenAI, OpenRouter, Groq, vLLM, or any OpenAI-API-shaped endpoint that requires its own key. Can also be set via `MY_AGENT_PROVIDER` in `.env`.

loom.anthropicApiKey.markdownDescription:
**Loom: Anthropic**

Deprecated plaintext Anthropic API key fallback.
loom.anthropicApiKey.deprecationMessage: Use the 'Loom: Set Anthropic API Key' command instead.

loom.model.markdownDescription:
**Loom: Anthropic**

Anthropic model id. Can also be set via `MY_AGENT_MODEL` in `.env`.

loom.openai.apiKey.markdownDescription:
**Loom: OpenAI**

Deprecated plaintext OpenAI API key fallback.
loom.openai.apiKey.deprecationMessage: Use the 'Loom: Set OpenAI API Key' command instead.

loom.openai.baseUrl.markdownDescription:
**Loom: OpenAI**

OpenAI base URL. Leave empty for api.openai.com, or point at an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Also `OPENAI_BASE_URL`.

loom.openai.model.markdownDescription:
**Loom: OpenAI**

OpenAI model id. Can also be set via `OPENAI_MODEL` in `.env`.

loom.openai.reasoningEffort.markdownDescription:
**Loom: OpenAI**

Reasoning effort for reasoning-capable models. Empty uses provider default. Also `OPENAI_REASONING_EFFORT`.

loom.local.baseUrl.markdownDescription:
**Loom: Local**

OpenAI-compatible local endpoint base URL.

loom.openaiCompatible.baseUrl.markdownDescription:
**Loom: OpenAI-Compatible**

Base URL for an OpenAI-compatible endpoint (Azure OpenAI, OpenRouter, Groq, vLLM, etc.). Also `OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_BASE_URL`.

loom.openaiCompatible.model.markdownDescription:
**Loom: OpenAI-Compatible**

Model id passed through to the endpoint. Also `OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_MODEL`.

loom.openaiCompatible.reasoningEffort.markdownDescription:
**Loom: OpenAI-Compatible**

Reasoning effort for reasoning-capable models on the endpoint. Empty uses provider default.

loom.mcp.servers.markdownDescription:
**Loom: MCP Servers**

Model Context Protocol stdio servers keyed by server name. Example: `{ "fs": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem", "${workspaceFolder}"] } }`.

loom.telemetry.enabled.markdownDescription:
**Loom: Telemetry**

Opt-in anonymous usage telemetry (tool call counts, durations, token totals). No file contents or prompts are sent. Disabled by default.

loom.telemetry.endpoint.markdownDescription:
**Loom: Telemetry Endpoint**

HTTPS endpoint that receives batched telemetry events. Leave blank to drop events locally (useful for verifying instrumentation without a backend).

loom.embeddings.provider.markdownDescription:
**Loom: Embeddings Provider**

Provider used to embed code for `semantic_search`. `ollama` uses a local Ollama instance; `voyage` uses Voyage AI (requires `VOYAGE_API_KEY`).

loom.embeddings.model.markdownDescription:
**Loom: Embeddings Model**

Model id for the embeddings provider (e.g. `nomic-embed-text` for Ollama, `voyage-code-3` for Voyage). Leave blank for the provider's default.

loom.modes.markdownDescription:
**Loom: Custom Modes**

User-defined agent modes. Each entry overrides a built-in mode of the same `id` or adds a new one.

id.description: Unique mode identifier. Overrides a built-in if it matches code, architect, ask, or debug.

label.description: Display label shown in the mode dropdown.

systemPrompt.description: Inline system prompt for this mode.

toolDenylist.description: Tool names to block in this mode. Mutually exclusive with toolAllowlist.

toolAllowlist.description: If present, only these tools are available. An empty array means no tools. Mutually exclusive with toolDenylist.

loom.ui.density.markdownDescription: **Loom: UI Density** — Row height and padding density.

loom.ui.themeBias.markdownDescription: **Loom: UI Theme Bias** — Force dark or light token set, or auto-detect from VS Code theme.

scripts.build: npm run build:agent && npm run build:webview && npm run build:ts
